findings.summary: Feature-pruned Dawn and SDL_GPU configurations left shared PAL helpers unreferenced; the existing maybe_unused convention is now applied symmetrically to those helpers without adding per-scene preprocessor branches
An unused splat result was initially handled as a one-off value-kind exception; auto locals now reuse the final generated-output liveness pass that already marks unused numeric locals
The shared background vertex aggregate omitted deformation fields when that feature was compiled; explicit zero initializers now keep the single shared packing path complete for every feature shape

Numeric comparisons carried parentheses both from expression lowering and their statement sink; comparison lowering now relies on the sink's required outer pair while logical composition retains its precedence-preserving grouping

Discarded results from inlined user functions produced bare C++ value expressions; result provenance now reaches the shared statement sink, which explicitly discards only those values and preserves established intrinsic output
